description: Spring SQL receivers are injected fields, so the template or entity manager is typed only by its declaration.  The declared type, not the field name, selects the SQL sink: JdbcTemplate, NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, the getJdbcTemplate() accessor and EntityManager all fire on a concatenated statement, and the placeholder forms stay quiet.

expected.notes: field typed NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, the receiver name does not end in jdbcTemplate
batchUpdate was not a SQL verb
placeholder and named-parameter forms bind the value
the parameterised statements are not structural sinks either
